SELECT
  datasetkey, publishingorgkey, institutioncode, basisofrecord, occurrencestatus,
  "year", "month", classkey, orderkey,
  GBIF_EEARGCode(1000, decimallatitude, decimallongitude, 0) AS eeacellcode,
  CASE
    WHEN coordinateuncertaintyinmeters IS NULL THEN 'unknown'
    WHEN coordinateuncertaintyinmeters <= 100 THEN '0-100m'
    WHEN coordinateuncertaintyinmeters <= 1000 THEN '100m-1km'
    WHEN coordinateuncertaintyinmeters <= 10000 THEN '1-10km'
    ELSE '>10km' END AS uncertaintyclass,
  COUNT(*) AS n_records,
  COUNT(DISTINCT specieskey) AS n_species,
  MIN(eventdategte) AS first_eventdate,
  MAX(eventdatelte) AS last_eventdate
FROM occurrence
WHERE countrycode = 'NO'
  AND hascoordinate = TRUE
  AND level1gid = 'NOR.15_1'
  AND "year" = 2020
GROUP BY
  datasetkey, publishingorgkey, institutioncode, basisofrecord, occurrencestatus,
  "year", "month", classkey, orderkey,
  GBIF_EEARGCode(1000, decimallatitude, decimallongitude, 0),
  CASE
    WHEN coordinateuncertaintyinmeters IS NULL THEN 'unknown'
    WHEN coordinateuncertaintyinmeters <= 100 THEN '0-100m'
    WHEN coordinateuncertaintyinmeters <= 1000 THEN '100m-1km'
    WHEN coordinateuncertaintyinmeters <= 10000 THEN '1-10km'
